name: prizm-checker
description: Audit a repo for alignment with the PRIZM design system and produce a diagnostic report with a % alignment score across five axes: tokens (A1), component adoption (A2), fidelity (A3), composition (A4), and accessibility (A5). Source passes, including WCAG AA contrast on colour pairs resolvable from source (PRIZM's own policy); contrast on layout-inherited backgrounds needs a rendered pass. Covers React/Next web products and JavaFX thick clients.
